title: rosa glauca var. cinerea
intro: Rosa glauca var. cinerea, commonly known as the Grey-leaved Wild Rose, is a shrubby plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa glauca var. cinerea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
